recipe.visualDefinition: A group portrait of four men in casual southern attire standing in a grassy field under a cloudy sky, featuring a large distressed title in the foreground and a clean subtitle at the top.
coreVisualRelationships: Foreground subject centered and slightly larger to create depth
Text-to-subject overlap where the main title sits over the lower bodies
Color harmony between the muted green landscape and the desaturated clothing
Contrast between the clean upper text and the weathered lower text
coreInvariants: Rural field background with a visible treeline
Cloudy, slightly overcast lighting with soft shadows

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Four subjects arranged in a staggered V-formation; the central figure is largest and closest to the lens.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central figure's face and the large distressed white text at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the central figure, move up to the top subtitle, then drop down to the large textured title at the base.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Ample space in the upper third for the sky and secondary text.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Muted earth tones (olive green, tan, denim blue) in the landscape and clothing.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Desaturated teal-grey sky providing a cool backdrop for the warm-toned subjects.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Bright white for all typography to ensure legibility against complex backgrounds.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high value contrast in the typography.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid neon or highly vibrant colors

letterConstructionRules: Heavy weathering and erosion effects applied to the main title
characterSpecificRedesigns: Subtitle features subtle drop shadows for legibility against clouds
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast between a heavy, distressed display face and a clean, spaced-out condensed sans-serif.

preserve: Distressed texture on the main title
avoid: Clean edges on the primary title

candidateDirections.nameOrCategory: Impact or Headline with grunge mask
candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy weight and blocky nature of the main title
Matches the condensed, clean look of the subtitle

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a wide-angle photograph of four men in their 30s standing in a grassy field with a treeline in the distance. They are wearing casual button-down shirts and jeans. The lighting is overcast and slightly desaturated with a cool-toned sky. The central man is slightly in front of the others.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply a large, bold, white sans-serif title across the bottom third with a heavy eroded/grunge texture. Add a smaller, clean, condensed sans-serif subtitle at the very top with wide letter spacing and a subtle drop shadow.

verificationChecks: Is the main title heavily textured and white?
Is the subtitle clean and widely spaced?
Are the subjects arranged in a staggered depth formation?
Is the color palette muted and naturalistic?

adjustableVariables: Amount of tracking in the subtitle
Depth of field in the background landscape
mustRedesign: Distinctive facial features of the original subjects

avoid: Generic, untextured fonts for the main title

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the text does not obscure the faces of the subjects
Check that the grunge texture looks organic and not like a repetitive pattern
Verify that the white text is readable against the sky and grass
Confirm the staggered depth of the subjects is maintained
recipe.reuseFormula: Rural landscape + staggered group portrait + [Distressed Bold Sans-Serif Title] + [Clean Condensed Subtitle]
